## Rule

**SOLVED (2026-06-06, generator-derived + 200k-proven).** ARC-GEN `task_53b68214.py`:
a `tall×wide` sprite (tall∈{1..3}, wide∈{1..3}) stamps at row `dr·tall`, col
`dr·(wide−1)·diag + sprite_col + offset` for dr=0,1,2,… Input = top H rows
(H∈5..8, **width always 10**) of the 10×10 output. Net effect: **vertical period
`t ∈ {2,3}`, horizontal shift per period `s = (wide−1)·diag ∈ {0,1,2}`** (s>0 only
with t=2; t=3 only at H=8; t=1 ≡ (2,0)).

Closed form: `out[r][c] = P[(r mod t)][c − s·(r div t)]`, OOB → 0, where
P = input rows 0..4. Hypothesis space is exactly **{(2,0),(3,0),(2,1),(2,2)}**.

Generator-derived invariants (all corpus-verified on 200k):
- in-shapes ∈ (5..8)×10 exactly; out always 10×10 (§CROP-CONTRACT satisfied).
- Row 0 only receives the dr=0 stamp ⇒ `P[0][c]=0` for c ≥ 6 (max stamp col =
  (wide−1)+offset ≤ 5). Flat index 9 is a free always-zero OOB sentinel.
- Hypothesis distribution: (2,0) 56.2%, (3,0) 12.6%, (2,1) 15.7%, (2,2) 15.6%.

## Algorithm sketch

`prototypes/numpy_ref_task124.py` — **200,000/200,000 exact** vs ARC-GEN truth.
Priority-test on rows 0..4: m20 = (P[2:5]==P[0:3]); m30 = (P[3:5]==P[0:2]);
m21 = (P[2:5,1:]==P[0:3,:9]); pick first match else (2,2); gather through the
(t,s) index map. Priority-order false positives are jointly impossible for
nonempty sprites (proofs in the builder docstrings; corpus-confirmed).

### CURRENT BEST — v11 `mapselect_lfactor` (cost 2,149 = mem 1,755 + params 394, 0 MACs)

- **Gates**: visible **267/267** · truth **200,000/200,000 (100.000%)** · ab
  **200,267/200,267, divergences=0, byte_equal=True** (gold class). LIVE itself
  is 100% on truth (n=5000) ⇒ **DETERMINISTIC class** (§CLASS-CHECK). v9 and
  v10 were each ALSO fully gated before being superseded.
- **Staged**: `staged_submits/task124_v11_mapselect_lfactor_cost2149/` (manifest
  has sha256 + full gate dump). Builder: `prototypes/build_task124_v11.py`.
  v6 (2,559) kept staged as the mechanism-diverse fallback (real Gram tensor,
  full-equality m21, full-width MAPS, no multi-operand einsums).
- **Architecture** (static opset-13): negpad 1×1 Conv → P [1,1,5,10]. The whole
  detection stage is **four scalar einsums** (#46/§42 addendum — kernel-internal
  scratch is cost-free): exact s=0 tests as factored quadratic forms
  `'rc,abcd,re,abed->'(L,P,L,P)` with L = row-difference factors (15p/10p; the
  [5,5] Gram never exists as a graph tensor); centroid bit `dW =
  'abcd,c,wdxy->'(P,rowsel±,Wc)` (Conv-weight reuse via size-1 subscripts) and
  `S0 = 'abcd,c->'`; m21 = `Less(dW, 1.5·S₀)`, margin ≥ 0.5·S₀ ≥ 0.5 F32-exact,
  valid because m20/m30 failing PROVES s∈{1,2} (priority-completeness proofs
  above). Scalar Where-chain → h; winTop = Slice(PU,0:2) verbatim (rows 0-1
  hypothesis-invariant); rows 2-9 = `Gather(MAPS [4,1,1,8,10] INT32, h)` →
  `Gather(flatU8)` → Concat → win [1,1,10,10] U8 → `Pad(value=255)` →
  [1,1,30,30] → `Equal(winPad, arange-U8)` = the free output node. OOB → flat 9.
- Δ vs LIVE: −13,238 (ln 15387/2149 = **+1.97** raw single-task estimate).

## Cost analysis

v11 memory 1,755: winPad [1,1,30,30] U8 900 · M8 [1,1,8,10] INT32 320 · P 200 ·
win(Concat) 100 · winBot 80 · PU/flatU 100 · winTop 20 · einsum/test/h scalars 35.
Params 394: MAPS 320 · L20/L30 25 · Wc 10 · arange 10 · rowsel± 10 ·
pad/slice/misc 19.

**Architecture-floor argument (~2.1k; v11 ≈ the floor):**
1. **Pre-output expansion ≥ 900 B**: output must be one-hot [1,10,30,30]; the
   cheapest known pre-output tensor is the U8 color canvas [1,1,30,30] = 900 B
   with the one-hot Equal as the free output node. The [1,10,10,10]-BOOL
   alternative costs 1,000 B + free Pad. No cheaper expansion exists in the
   validated op library (one-hot-LUT gather: 2,400; OneHot-F16: 2,800;
   bit-plane BitwiseAnd needs a U16 canvas = 1,800; Conv-bias
   product-of-linear-forms one-hot needs a 2×36,000 B pre-output pair).
2. **Gather machine ≈ 940 (mem 620 + params 320)**: hypothesis-variant rows
   2-9 need 320p of maps + M8 320 B (Gather indices are INT32-min — sub-INT32
   idx is an ORT load failure) + winBot/winTop/Concat/cast/flat 300 B.
   Priced-and-rejected: arithmetic map synthesis in every layout (incl.
   stride-3 flat and zero-tail negative-wrap — row-1 OOB cells wrap to
   positive indices into row 0, unfixable without a per-cell Where; 4
   independent disproofs); Tile-route for the (2,0) map (+8); full-width MAPS
   (v6, +57); ConvTranspose pattern-stamping with runtime-gathered placement
   kernels (1,472 vs 943); runtime-starts Slice (constant extent unprovable to
   strict shape inference → calculate_memory None, 025-class); CANDS-first
   gather order (exactly cost-neutral).
3. **Detection ≈ 270**: P [1,1,5,10] F32 200 B is forced (Conv output is F32;
   einsum cannot crop, so the colorize cannot fuse into the test einsums
   without [·,30]-extent selector params; verification provably needs all 5
   rows — see Don't-do on the 4-row trap). The tests themselves are four
   scalar einsums + L/rowsel params ≈ 70 units (#46/§42 multi-operand fusion:
   the Gram and all marginals live as kernel-internal scratch, cost-free).
   The two exact tests cannot be moment-ized (cross-class moment collisions
   would be real bugs); the third is a 1-bit moment, already minimal.
Sub-2k now misses by ~150: the remaining mass is winPad 900 + the 640-unit
index machine + P 200, each multiply-disproven. A sub-2k build would need a
new primitive (cheaper one-hot expansion or sub-INT32 gather indices —
neither exists in ORT). The prompt's "sub-2k if plain periodic tiling"
doesn't apply: the diag variant (31% of corpus) forces the hypothesis
machinery and per-cell column shifts (plain `Tile` cannot express them).

## Don't-do log

- **OneHot INT32-indices "ORT fail" (v3) was a MISDIAGNOSIS** — traps §2: ORT
  accepts INT32 indices iff `depth` is also INT32 (v3 paired INT32 idx with
  INT64 depth). Moot for v6 (no OneHot), but don't re-propagate the old rule.
- **`crop_to_size_advisory` (−32k SPREAD estimate below) is a FALSE POSITIVE**
  — traps #26: the only [1,*,30,30] tensors in LIVE/v6 are the model output
  (excluded from memory) and v6's 900 B winPad. There is no 32k to harvest.
- **Do NOT verify on only 4 rows (rows 0..3)**: the (3,0) test P[3]==P[0] has a
  real false-positive family vs (2,s) patterns (row1>>s == row0 is satisfiable).
  Row 4 closes it: P[4]==P[1] additionally requires row0>>2s == row1, jointly
  ⇒ row1>>3s == row1 ⇒ empty sprite. 5 rows are necessary AND sufficient.
- **Pad-before-Equal MUST pad with a non-color value (255)**: padding win with
  0 lights ch0=1 across the whole 30×30 canvas outside the active grid (breaks
  the encoder contract: outside = ALL channels 0). Caught at design time.
- **No F16 verify path**: ORT Einsum supports float/double/int32/int64 ONLY —
  F16 Sub/Mul/ReduceSum chains save ~300 B but lose the einsum SSDs; net worse.
- **fp16_selective spread pass**: +31,086 regression (2026-05-18 sweep) — the
  Cast-sandwich tax; superseded by the targeted U8/BOOL dtype work in v6.
